scope_note: Dated evidence catalog, not a production capability or calibration registry. Exhaustive within the text-model menus inspected on four signed-in accounts on 2026-09-09, including visible gated choices. Public documentation adds scoped plan, routing and media information; it does not exhaust every region, rollout, private Enterprise configuration, agent submodel or hidden fallback. Gemini's inspected account was a work account. Media and separate agent-model menus were not inspected. ui_observed means the label or option was seen, not that it was runnable, selected or tested. API IDs remain empty unless explicitly documented and matched to the observed model. Every energy profile is not_calibrated.

entries.name: Latest

notes: A moving UI label. Do not map all Latest requests to one physical model or tokenizer.

entries.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
entries.availability: Observed as selectable. Official paid-plan availability: Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise, with plan-specific reasoning options and workspace controls.
notes: The same-day protocol audit observed gpt-5-6-thinking for an Extra High response. This is a bounded consumer-protocol observation, not a universal Latest alias or verified developer API identifier.
Free and Go default to Luna and do not receive Sol.
